beginner.summary: For system administrators and DevOps engineers who manage Linux or Windows servers by hand or with scripts and are new to Puppet. Covers installing a Puppet 8 agent and Puppet Server (Puppet Core, Puppet Enterprise or the OpenVox community build), the resource model, manifests and puppet apply, core resource types, ordering and notification, data types and facts, conditionals, classes, modules from the Puppet Forge, EPP templates, the agent-server catalog cycle and certificate signing, Hiera 5 data, defined types, iteration, environments, reading run reports and exit codes, first steps with Bolt, and a capstone web server module.
prerequisites: Administers Linux servers from the shell: packages, services, users, file permissions and systemd units
Edits YAML and text configuration files and can read short Ruby or shell snippets
Has two or three lab VMs or containers (one for Puppet Server with at least 4 GB RAM) with root access and DNS or /etc/hosts name resolution between them
outcomes: Install and connect a Puppet agent to a Puppet Server, sign its certificate and apply catalogs with puppet agent -t
Write idempotent manifests using core resource types, typed class parameters, relationships, conditionals and iteration
Package configuration as a module with classes, defined types, EPP templates and Hiera 5 data
Read agent output, noop results and detailed exit codes to confirm what changed and why
